title: Scourging Slayer

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Scourging Slayer is the upgraded form of Slayer using the Iolite. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Iolite, it has 10 additional lightning damage and a 25% chance to apply Chain Lightning.
An upgraded Slayer will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones

sections.heading: Upgrade information
sections.text: Total cost for the fully upgraded sword is 1 Slayer, 105 Flametal and 6 Iolites. However, it is only 30 Flametal and 2 Iolites for level 2, which is the highest upgrade currently obtainable as of patch 218.15.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The primary attacks are fairly vertical and wide-reaching, with the third attack in the combo being more narrow in the horizontal plane.
• The secondary attack is a long reaching thrust that is capable of outreaching most enemies with very excellent damage.

Introduction. Scourging Slayer is the upgraded form of Slayer using the Iolite. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Iolite, it has 10 additional lightning damage and a 25% chance to apply Chain Lightning.
An upgraded Slayer will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones

Upgrade information. Total cost for the fully upgraded sword is 1 Slayer, 105 Flametal and 6 Iolites. However, it is only 30 Flametal and 2 Iolites for level 2, which is the highest upgrade currently obtainable as of patch 218.15.

Notes. • The primary attacks are fairly vertical and wide-reaching, with the third attack in the combo being more narrow in the horizontal plane.
• The secondary attack is a long reaching thrust that is capable of outreaching most enemies with very excellent damage.
